queries.name: RAN1_P3_CQ008
queries.query: MATCH (:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sourceSpec:Spec) WITH DISTINCT sourceSpec.specNumber AS specNumber OPTIONAL MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber:specNumber}) WITH specNumber,count(DISTINCT sec) AS sectionCount OPTIONAL MATCH (tbl:TSTable)-[:TABLE_IN_SECTION]->(:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber:specNumber}) WITH specNumber,sectionCount,count(DISTINCT tbl) AS tableCount OPTIONAL MATCH (fig:TSFigure)-[:FIGURE_IN_SECTION]->(:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber:specNumber}) RETURN specNumber,sectionCount,tableCount,count(DISTINCT fig) AS figureCount
queries.SQL:
WITH owners AS (SELECT sec.node_id AS sectionNode, s.specNumber
            FROM Section sec JOIN edge b ON b.src_id=sec.node_id AND b.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=b.dst_id),
            domain AS (SELECT DISTINCT specNumber FROM owners)
            SELECT d.specNumber AS specNumber,
              (SELECT count(DISTINCT o.sectionNode) FROM owners o WHERE o.specNumber=d.specNumber) AS sectionCount,
              (SELECT count(DISTINCT t.src_id) FROM edge t JOIN owners o ON o.sectionNode=t.dst_id WHERE o.specNumber=d.specNumber AND t.rel_type='TABLE_IN_SECTION') AS tableCount,
              (SELECT count(DISTINCT f.src_id) FROM edge f JOIN owners o ON o.sectionNode=f.dst_id WHERE o.specNumber=d.specNumber AND f.rel_type='FIGURE_IN_SECTION') AS figureCount
            FROM domain d

queries.name: RAN1_P3_CQ041
queries.query: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(tbl:TSTable) WITH sec,count(DISTINCT tbl) AS tableCount WHERE tableCount>=5 RETURN sec.sectionId,tableCount
queries.SQL:
SELECT s.sectionId AS "sec.sectionId",count(DISTINCT t.node_id) AS tableCount
            FROM Section s JOIN edge r ON r.src_id=s.node_id AND r.rel_type='CONTAINS_TABLE'
            JOIN TSTable t ON t.node_id=r.dst_id GROUP BY s.node_id,s.sectionId
            HAVING count(DISTINCT t.node_id)>=5
